gaps.valueSet: LCMV culture, tissue-antigen, and generic CSF nucleic-acid test names
gaps.reason: the authoritative source reports no LOINC codes for the LCMV-specific culture test, both antigen test value sets, and the generic CSF nucleic-acid test; LYCH-R2 retains coded generic culture alternatives, while source rule 4 is omitted entirely because every test-name branch is unavailable

gaps.valueSet: CSF, blood, serum, and tissue specimen constraints
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no specimen-type evidence or predicate, and the source HL7 specimen value sets are unavailable; unrestricted LCMV nucleic-acid, generic nucleic-acid, and antibody test branches requiring separate specimen evidence are omitted from LYCH-R3 and LYCH-R5 while specimen-specific test-name alternatives remain modeled
